propositions: Review gate criterion runners cannot distinguish clean execution from failed, cancelled, skipped, budget-shed, or resumed outcomes, causing plan-review to create empty successful checkpoints and code-review to lose earlier work when later criteria fail.

A new independent discovery kernel submodule must define immutable input plans, typed per-unit outcomes, and a versioned digest-complete envelope covering material/code/policy/topology without modifying existing verify/decide/coach kernels.

The executor must perform dependency-aware scheduling, deterministic budget shedding by ascending dependency rank and unit id, and return exact completed/failed/cancelled accounting without fabricating usage when systemic failures or cancellations occur.

Successful and content-identical resumed units alone may round-trip as reusable checkpoints; failed, cancelled, skipped, and shed units remain missing, preserving independent earlier results when later units fail.

Stored traces must be normalized diagnostic metadata and lineage only, excluding raw prompts, ticket/context bodies, provider responses, and secrets, with no schema changes to existing review/review-status contracts.

Cancellation observation reuses the existing cut point from generation.review_cancelled(), where already-dispatched calls commit as true outcomes with real usage and not-yet-dispatched units are marked cancelled.
